items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1976-02-19
items.q: We know, here in New Orleans, certainly we know that Lorenzo Teo wrote Mood Indigo some eight years before...

ctx.x: Well, I think that it's interesting. I think that it's interesting that Duke Ellington has developed the reputation that he has. Uh, really, uh, uh, uh, that he has accepted as being a great musical genius. Uh, one thing is, of course, that so far as I am able to determine on the basis of what I considered to be reasonable investigation. First, that he was not, in fact, a composer, that he never really composed anything at all of any significance, certainly none of the things with which his name is identified.…
Jimmy Noon's soul became the Creole Love Call. Jimmy Noon's solo in one of the King Oliver pieces.
